description.value: Zambri's has been serving honest, authentic Italian food in downtown Victoria since 1999, earning a loyal following and critical recognition over more than two decades. Founded by Peter Zambri and now co-led by Executive Chef Julia McInnis, the restaurant occupies the Atrium building and draws on seasonal, local ingredients for its ever-changing feature menus. Private dining rooms accommodating up to 55 guests make it a popular destination for celebrations, and delivery via Uber Eats extends its reach beyond dine-in.
